title: RO-MT087-RoleRuntimeProofs

scope.summary:
GOAL: Live runtime proof of the whole RO family — no mocks standing in for spec-required runtime. Two proof pillars: (A) TRANSPORT PARITY: the SAME Handshake Role (one registry row, one overlay_sha256) injected across all three transports — Claude CLI (stream-json), Codex CLI (app-server), and an ACP agent — with recorded role_injected events AND init-transcript evidence that the overlay actually took effect in each session; (B) IMPORTER ROUND-TRIP: the MT-084 importer run against at least 2 REAL .GOV role protocols (read-only source), drafts created, and the operator-approval flow (MT-085 approve-draft -> MT-081 activate) exercised to an injectable active role. Where a real CLI is absent on the proof host, the affected scenario records a typed NEEDS_MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROOF blocker — never a green claim, never a mock substitute.

EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE: Proof test files under src/backend/handshake_core/tests/ (test_role_runtime_proofs.rs + role_proof_support module) and a machine-readable proof manifest (role_proof_manifest.json under the tests tree) recording per-scenario verdicts PASS / FAIL / NEEDS_MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROOF with evidence pointers. Minor test-support-only seams if a probe hook is missing. No product feature code beyond what MT-081..086 shipped; this MT proves, it does not implement (gaps found here route back to the owning MT as remediation).

DETAILED SPEC — proof scenarios:
- RP-01 claude-injection-live: activate a probe role whose overlay instructs: first assistant message MUST begin with ROLE_ACK:{role_id}@v{version}. Launch a real Claude CLI session (stream-json output) with MT-082 append-file injection; assert (a) role_injected FR event with matching overlay_sha256, (b) temp overlay file existed at spawn and is swept after session end, (c) init transcript's first assistant turn carries the ROLE_ACK marker (overlay demonstrably in effect, not just passed as args).
- RP-02 codex-injection-live: same probe role via the Codex app-server transport; assert the first-turn input contains the frozen delimiter block (harness-side capture) and the first response carries ROLE_ACK (overlay in effect through the first-turn-prefix path).
- RP-03 acp-injection-live: same probe role via the MT-061 ACP agent path; assert first prompt segment framing + ROLE_ACK + role_injected event. If no real ACP agent binary is available, typed NEEDS_MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROOF.
- RP-04 same-role-parity: cross-check RP-01..03 evidence: identical role_id/version/overlay_sha256 across all three role_injected events; manifest row asserts the parity join, proving one role definition steers all transports.
- RP-05 importer-round-trip: run the MT-084 importer with roles-source configured to the real .GOV/roles/ directory (read-only) covering at least orchestrator/ORCHESTRATOR_PROTOCOL.md and coder/CODER_PROTOCOL.md; assert >=2 drafts with imported provenance + correct source_ref hashes; assert source tree byte-identical after import.
- RP-06 approval-flow-live: take one RP-05 draft through the operator-approval flow (MT-085 approve path or its API equivalent with the GUI evidence from MT-085's Argus targets referenced); assert draft->active transition ledger event; then inject the newly-activated imported role in ONE available transport and capture ROLE_ACK — the full migration story proven end-to-end: repo-gov protocol -> draft -> operator approval -> live injected session.
- RP-07 negative-guard-live: attempt to inject (a) a draft role and (b) a tampered overlay (sha mismatch) against a real transport path; assert typed errors, no session spawn, no role_injected event.
- Manifest: role_proof_manifest.json rows { scenario_id, transport, role_ref, verdict, evidence: [FR event ids, transcript paths, screenshot/artifact paths], blocker_reason? } written atomically; transcripts and captures go to the external artifacts root, never into the repo worktree.

STEP-BY-STEP IMPLEMENTATION:
1. Preflight: detect available real CLIs (claude, codex, ACP agent binary) via the existing preflight_version pattern in official_cli_bridge.rs; map absent CLIs to NEEDS_MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROOF rows up front.
2. Author the probe role (deterministic ROLE_ACK overlay) as a test fixture registered through the real MT-081 API (not direct DB writes).
3. Implement RP-01 with real Claude CLI spawn, stream-json capture (capture_cli_stream pattern in operator_chat.rs), FR event assertion, temp-file sweep assertion.
4. Implement RP-02/RP-03 per transport; keep per-scenario hard timeouts so an unresponsive CLI yields FAIL-with-timeout, never a hang.
5. Implement RP-04 parity join over recorded events.
6. Implement RP-05 against the real .GOV/roles source (env-configured absolute path passed by the proof runner; the test itself hardcodes nothing) with pre/post source-tree hash comparison.
7. Implement RP-06 approval + live injection of the imported role.
8. Implement RP-07 negative guards on a real path.
9. Manifest assembly (atomic write) + evidence routing to the external artifacts root.
10. Sweep check: after the suite, zero orphan overlay temp files and zero surviving child processes (process-ledger reclamation assertion).
allowed_paths: src/backend/handshake_core/src/** (test-support probe seams only, disclosed per seam)
forbidden_paths: app/src/** except named IPC read surfaces
.GOV/** (role protocols are read-only source material; importer reads, never writes)
src/frontend/handshake_native/** (GUI evidence comes from MT-085 Argus artifacts, referenced not re-implemented)
acceptance_criteria: RP-01: live Claude CLI session injected via append-file shows ROLE_ACK in the first assistant turn, role_injected FR event matches the registry overlay_sha256, and the temp overlay file is swept after session end.
RP-02: live Codex app-server session shows the frozen delimiter block in captured first-turn input and ROLE_ACK in the first response.
RP-03: live ACP session proves first-segment injection + ROLE_ACK, or records a typed NEEDS_MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROOF blocker when no real agent binary exists.
RP-04: the three transports' role_injected events carry identical role_id/version/overlay_sha256 (same-role parity join).
RP-05: importer run against the real .GOV/roles source yields >=2 imported-provenance drafts with correct source_ref hashes and a byte-identical source tree afterward.
RP-06: one imported draft is operator-approved to active and then live-injected with ROLE_ACK captured (full repo-gov -> product round trip).
RP-07: draft-role and sha-tampered injection attempts fail typed on a real transport path with no session spawn and no role_injected event.

role_proof_manifest.json contains one row per scenario with verdict PASS / FAIL / NEEDS_MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROOF and evidence pointers; no scenario is silently skipped and no mock substitutes for an absent CLI.
Post-suite sweep: zero orphan overlay temp files, zero surviving spawned processes.
All transcripts/captures land under the external artifacts root, none inside the repo worktree.
proof_targets: python -c "import json;m=json.load(open('src/backend/handshake_core/tests/role_proof_support/role_proof_manifest.json'));assert all(r['verdict'] in ('PASS','FAIL','NEEDS_MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROOF') for r in m) and len(m)>=7;print('manifest ok',len(m))"
grep -c 'ROLE_ACK' <captured transcript artifacts under the external artifacts root>  # >=1 per live transport scenario
post-suite sweep assertion: no orphan overlay temp files, no surviving child processes (asserted inside the suite, printed to --nocapture output)
implementation_notes: Reuse verified product mechanics: preflight_version + LiveCliSpawner in official_cli_bridge.rs for CLI detection/spawn; capture_cli_stream / ModelLaneCaptureRecorder in operator_chat.rs for transcript capture; process ledger for spawn/reclaim assertions.

ROLE_ACK is a behavioral probe: it proves the overlay reached the model's effective instruction set, which arg-presence alone cannot prove. Keep the probe overlay tiny and deterministic; a compliant model echoing the marker is the acceptance signal, and a missing marker on an otherwise-healthy session is a FAIL for that transport's injection path, to be triaged against MT-082.

Typed-blocker discipline (WP-KERNEL-012 MT-045 precedent): absent CLI/agent binaries produce NEEDS_MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROOF manifest rows — the precise managed-resource proof backlog — never PASS/GREEN language and never mock substitution.
RP-05/RP-06 are the operator's migration story proof; the roles-source path is injected via env/config by the proof runner (portability: the test binary hardcodes no repo-external path).
Every live CLI interaction is timeout-bounded and headless (HBR-QUIET): no foreground windows, no focus stealing, all child processes reclaimed.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Runtime proof MT: consumes MT-085's Argus evidence for the approval-flow GUI leg (referenced in RP-06 evidence pointers) but creates no new operator surface; role_proof_manifest.json + FR events + external transcripts are the trace projection.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Proof-only MT; product behaviors were documented by MT-081/085/086 manual entries. If proofs expose a behavior/manual mismatch, remediation routes to the owning MT with its manual duty.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.behavior: live role injection across three transports + importer round-trip + approval flow
hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT consumes and asserts the Tier-1 FR evidence produced by MT-082/086; internal_diagnostics/Palmistry not yet shipped in wtc-multi-model-orchestration-v1 — recorded DEFERRED with integration follow-up per HBR-INT-009.

risk_if_missed: The RO family ships on arg-construction faith: nobody has proven a role actually steers a live session on any transport, transport parity is asserted not evidenced, the repo-gov migration story is untested end-to-end, and validators inherit an unprovable feature.

risks: RISK-1: Arg-presence theater — proofs assert the injection args/bytes were constructed but never that the overlay took effect in the model's behavior; a broken flag passes green.
RISK-2: Mock substitution under CLI absence — a stub 'CLI' echoing ROLE_ACK fakes a live pass on hosts without the real binaries.
RISK-3: Proof-run pollution — live sessions leave orphan overlay temp files, surviving child processes, or transcripts written inside the repo worktree.
RISK-4: Hanging live CLIs — an unresponsive real CLI stalls the suite indefinitely, so the proof run never terminates (the exact failure mode the WP-012 validation history records).
RISK-5: Parity by coincidence — three green scenarios that injected different role versions still 'pass' individually while disproving the same-role claim.
minimum_controls: CTRL-1 (RISK-1): ROLE_ACK behavioral probe required in every live scenario's first assistant turn; arg assertions are supplementary, never sufficient.

CTRL-2 (RISK-2): CLI presence via preflight_version against the real executable path; absent binary -> typed NEEDS_MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROOF row; the suite contains no ROLE_ACK-emitting stubs (grep-provable).
CTRL-3 (RISK-3): post-suite sweep assertion (zero orphan overlays, zero surviving processes) + external-artifacts-root routing test for every evidence file.
CTRL-4 (RISK-4): hard per-scenario timeouts with kill+reclaim on expiry; timeout yields FAIL-with-reason, never a hang.
CTRL-5 (RISK-5): RP-04 parity join over recorded events (identical role_id/version/overlay_sha256) is its own manifest row and acceptance criterion.

research_provenance.source: Verified transport research (Claude --append-system-prompt-file overlay semantics + stream-json; Codex app-server first-turn carrier; ACP harness-owned injection) + inspected proof mechanics in product code (official_cli_bridge.rs preflight_version/LiveCliSpawner/hostile_never_eof_reader_cleanup_probe; operator_chat.rs capture_cli_stream) + WP-KERNEL-012 MT-045 precedent for typed NEEDS_MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROOF manifests, atomic manifest writes, external artifacts routing, and timeout-bounded live suites + verified .GOV/roles protocol files as the RP-05 round-trip source.
corrections: Behavioral proof (ROLE_ACK in transcript) outranks construction proof (args present); both are recorded.
Absent managed resources produce typed blockers, never mocks and never green language (MT-045 lesson).
Same-role parity is an explicit joined assertion across transports, not three independent greens.
